tool.name: AMRfior
tool.description: AMR gene detection with built-in CARD/ResFinder/NCBI databases
tool.command: mkdir -p output_dir && AMRfior -i '$input' #if $sequence_type == 'Paired-FASTQ': ,'$input_r2' #end if -st '$sequence_type' -o output_dir -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} --databases #echo ' '.join($databases)# #if 'user-provided' in $databases and str($user_db_path): --user-db-path '$user_db_path' #end if #if $tools: --tools #echo ' '.join($tools)# #end if #if str($report_fasta) != 'None': --report-fasta '$report_fasta' #end if #if $sequence_type == 'Genes-FASTA': --genes-type '$genes_type' #end if --q-min-cov $q_min_cov --q-min-id $q_min_id --d-min-cov $d_min_cov --d-min-id $d_min_id --d-min-depth $d_min_depth --d-min-reads $d_min_reads #if $mode == 'dna-only': --dna-only #elif $mode == 'protein-only': --protein-only #end if #if str($sensitivity) != 'default': --sensitivity '$sensitivity' #end if --minimap2-preset '$minimap2_preset' --blastx-task '$blastx_task' -e $evalue #if $fastp_trim and $sequence_type == 'Paired-FASTQ': --fastp-trim #end if #for $tp in $tool_param: --tool-param '$tp.tool_name="$tp.params"' #end for #if $verbose: --verbose #end if && cd output_dir && find . -name '*_detection_matrix.tsv' -exec cp {} ../detection_matrix.tsv \; && find . -name '*_evidence_matrix.tsv' -exec cp {} ../evidence_matrix.tsv \; && find . -name '*_evidence_summary.tsv' -exec cp {} ../evidence_summary.tsv \; && find . -name '*_allele_resolution.tsv' -exec cp {} ../allele_resolution.tsv \; #if str($report_fasta) != 'None': && find . -name '*.fasta' -path '*/report*' -exec cp {} ../report_fasta.fasta \; || true #end if && cd .. && zip -r results_archive.zip output_dir

param.name: input
param.label: Input sequences
param.help: Input FASTA/FASTQ (.gz accepted). For Paired-FASTQ, provide R1 here and R2 below.

param.name: input_r2
param.label: R2 mate (Paired-FASTQ)
param.help: Second read file for paired-end FASTQ input

param.name: databases
param.label: AMR databases
param.help: Select built-in AMR databases to search against

param.name: user_db_path
param.label: User database path
param.help: Required if user-provided is selected. Comma-separated paths to user database directories

param.name: genes_type
param.label: Genes type
param.help: Required for Genes-FASTA: specify DNA or amino acid

param.name: mode
param.label: Tool mode
param.help: Restrict to DNA-only or protein-only tools

param.name: fastp_trim
param.label: Run fastp trimming
param.help: Trim reads with fastp before alignment (Paired-FASTQ only)

param.name: params
param.label: Parameters
param.help: Arguments to pass to the tool, e.g. "-e 1e-5"
